raw_segments.text: The greatest difficulty in antiquity was that of altering the law.
Amongst the moderns, it is that of altering the manners, and as far as we are concerned,
the real obstacles begin where those of the ancients left off.
This arises from the circumstance that, amongst the moderns, the abstract and transient fact
of slavery is fatally united to the physical and permanent fact of color.
